newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet says bid for Atlas unconditional.
newsitem.headline: Valmet says bid for Atlas unconditional.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Tuesday its bid for British Atlas Converting Equipment plc had become unconditional.
"As of July 14, 1997, Valmet either holds, or has received acceptances to its offer, in respect of a total of 85 percent of the issued share capital of Atlas," Valmet said in a statement.
"The remaining conditions of the offer by Valmet for the total share capital of the...company have been fulfilled or waived and the offer has become wholly unconditional," it said.
Valmet said the offer would remain open until further notice and that it intends to acquire the remaining Atlas shares and apply for delisting on the London Stock Exchange.
